label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated gathering with bread, probably in the great hall around the eighteen o'clock inspection. Baker wanted gathering bread arranged beforehand; innkeeper carried a bread sack, repeatedly confirmed the inspection time, and promised the hall would be ready. Neighbour and freight appear involved in arrangements or deliveries, though their knowing involvement is less certain. Secretary coordinates the appointment and builder will meet me, but neither is proven to know of any concealed gathering. The precise occasion, including whether it is a surprise for me, remains unverified.
